## SEPTIC BURSITIS
Obtain synovial fluid for gram stain and culture to guide therapy.
## Likely MSSA:
[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h [R]](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h)
## Likey MRSA:
[Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R]](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
## Step down to oral therapy
Likely MSSA:
[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R]](psjzid-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-q12h)
Likely MRSA:
[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID [R,DI]](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tab-bid)

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID [DI] for 14 days](psozid2-doxycycline-14ds-100mg-po-bid)
[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID [R,DI] for 14 days](psozid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tablet-14ds-po-bid)
